meta.title: tclock: a terminal clock with command widgets
meta.description: tclock, a maintained fork of clock-tui: terminal clock, timer, stopwatch and countdown, with command widgets and Evangelion and NERV themes. Prebuilt for Linux.

hero.title: A clock that is also a dashboard
hero.lede: tclock is my maintained fork of clock-tui: a terminal clock with timer, stopwatch and countdown modes. Its widgets run any command on a schedule and show the output under the clock, which turns my second monitor into a status board.
hero.evaAlt: tclock with the Evangelion theme: large pixel digits, a GitHub pending widget, a Google Calendar widget and a system health strip.
hero.nervAlt: tclock with the NERV theme: 17:34:24 in large red pixel digits over a dark sky, with GitHub pending, Google Calendar and system health widgets.
hero.caption: The same dashboard in two of the three built-in themes. Shift+T cycles them, and the widgets follow.

widgets.title: Any command becomes a widget
widgets.lede: A widget runs a command, captures its output with the ANSI colors intact, and refreshes on its own schedule. If it prints something useful and exits, it can live under the clock.
widgets.alt: A terminal with a red pixel clock on top and three widget panels below, amber, teal and green, each fed by a dashed line from a command box: ghpending, calendar and system health. Labelled Any command. Three theme swatches: default, evangelion, nerv.

config.lede: This is the actual file behind the screenshot, trimmed. The system health script ships with tclock as an example widget.

features.title: What I added to the fork

items.title: Command widgets
items.text: Up to six side by side on ultra-wide terminals, or a full-width band at the bottom sized to its output.

items.title: Themes
items.text: default, evangelion and nerv. The theme name is passed to every widget as TCLOCK_WIDGET_THEME so they can match.

items.title: Groups
items.text: Put widgets in groups and swap the whole set with g. Hidden widgets do not run.

items.title: Popups
items.text: Bind a key to a detail view: the widget's command with extra arguments, shown over the clock.

items.title: Clock-only mode
items.text: z hides every widget and centers the clock. Press it again to bring them back.

items.title: Packaging
items.text: Updated dependencies, release binaries for x86_64 and aarch64, an AUR package and shell completions.

modes.title: It is still a good clock
modes.lede: Clock, timer, stopwatch and countdown. Timers can chain durations and run a command when time is up.
modes.clockLabel: tclock in clock mode, digits ticking over.
modes.timerLabel: tclock in timer mode, counting down.

install.title: Install
install.binary: Download the tarball for your architecture from the releases page and put tclock on your PATH.
install.credit: tclock is a fork of race604/clock-tui, which paused a long time ago. The idea is theirs; the widgets, themes and packaging are mine.
